caseName: Anderson v. Wisconsin Department of Revenue
caseNameFull: Anderson v. Wisconsin Department of Revenue

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Wis.. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until November 30, 1992, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.

Justice Blackmun and Justice Stevens would grant certiorari.
